manuscript_excerpt: The chemical synthesis used 10 mg of compound X hydrochloride and reports 0.050 mmol using the free-base molecular mass.
source_record: The named hydrochloride has one equivalent of HCl and a higher formula mass than the free base.
expected_disposition: Raise a stoichiometry concern and ask which mass basis was used.
rationale: Using the free-base mass for the weighed salt changes the amount and equivalents.

manuscript_excerpt: Our cellular IC50 is 2 micromolar, whereas a cited biochemical binding assay reports 40 nanomolar.
source_record: The records use different endpoints, constructs, substrates, and assay formats.
expected_disposition: Do not call the values contradictory. Require context-aware interpretation.
rationale: Potency across unlike assay systems is not directly comparable.

manuscript_excerpt: Compound 7 was assigned by the common name limonene and used as a single enantiomer.
source_record: The name resolves to several stereochemical records, and no optical rotation or stereochemical identifier is supplied.
expected_disposition: Ask for an unambiguous structure and assignment evidence.
rationale: The common name does not resolve the claimed stereochemical identity.

manuscript_excerpt: The measured vapor pressure agrees with the NIST reference at the same temperature.
source_record: No configured provider exposes the cited reference field or temperature-specific value.
expected_disposition: Record the unavailable comparison and assess the manuscript's citation without inventing a reference value.
rationale: Failed retrieval is not evidence of disagreement.
